why: In section 1, the first problem the reader raises is that they never got a number. They say the box "כמה כסף נשאר לכם, ומתי?" only shows the link "הציגו את החישוב" and is closed. They repeat this in sections 2, 3, 6 and 7 ("it was closed", "opened, with a number"). This matches the problem: the calculation is hidden behind a fold and has to be opened.
